summary: @ornikar/repo-config-react-legacy-css preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: Package advertises itself as a shared CSS/React repo-config helper but declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs` in package.json. setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-style obfuscated (`_0xNNNNNN` identifier renaming, per-function scrambled string maps) and, at `npm install` time, downloads the Bun runtime zip from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<arch>.zip`, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a bundled 727KB `math_init.js` (`execFileSync(<bun>, [math_init.js], { cwd: D })`). math_init.js is heavily obfuscated with a rotating string array (`WV8StW` shifter over `n7gIxM`), an alphabet-substitution decoder (`hc1jfK9`), and `_0xNNNN` identifier renaming — its actual capabilities cannot be enumerated without decoding. Pulling a second language runtime at install to execute an opaque obfuscated payload is inconsistent with a CSS/repo-config helper and bypasses scanners that only trace Node-resolved code; the payload runs on every installer's host with the installer's privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
